name: Warmth Scroller
description:
Scroll up or down in the Top Bar while holding a modifier key (Shift by default) to make the screen warmer or cooler, using GNOME Night Light. Scrolling back to neutral (6500 K) turns Night Light off again and restores your own Night Light settings. The step size, the warmest temperature, the modifier key (None/Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Super) and the scroll direction are configurable.

The extension also runs on the lock screen (unlock-dialog session mode) only so that the chosen warmth is not reset every time the screen locks; scrolling is ignored while the screen is locked.

Derived from Volume Scroller (https://github.com/francislavoie/gnome-shell-volume-scroller) via Brightness Scroller (https://github.com/DavidWVMadsen/gnome-shell-brightness-scroller).
